title: Security Deposit Account: Correction Credits on Disputed Cleaning Lines
content:
**Rule.** A cleaning line under a dispute accepted because its cleaning charge was misapplied is not withdrawn: it stays on the statement at its corrected cleaning charge, and the excess of the cleaning charged over the corrected cleaning charge is credited against the balance owed by one dispute credit posted against the disputed cleaning line.

This rule governs the final account statement of a Security Deposit Account. It applies when a dispute recorded against a cleaning line has been accepted because the cleaning charge was misapplied. The credit is due for as long as that line has no dispute credit posted against it.

## Business effect

| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| The disputed cleaning line | Stays on the statement, at its corrected cleaning charge |
| The excess charged over the corrected charge | Credited against the balance owed |
| Number of credit lines | One dispute credit, posted against the disputed cleaning line |
| Everything else on the account | Unchanged |

## Posting the credit: `post_cleaning_correction_credit_249da733`

**What the tool does.** It posts one dispute credit on a Security Deposit Account that lowers the account's balance owed, on account of a disputed cleaning line that was corrected. One call records one new dispute-credit line on the final account statement. The line is tied to the single itemized cleaning line named as its source and is dated the day of posting. The amount credited reduces what the former resident still owes, and nothing else on the account changes. The credit line is visible at once in the account's transactions.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool. The agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `post_cleaning_correction_credit_249da733`, and then calls it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool` with the parameters below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_account_id` | Reference number of the Security Deposit Account that receives the credit, as returned by the deposit account lookup for this resident | Id |
| `source_transaction_id` | Reference number of the itemized cleaning line the credit is posted against, as returned by the deposit transaction lookup for this account | Id |
| `amount` | The credit amount in USD | Positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** A one-line text receipt beginning "Dispute credit posted". It gives, in order: the new credit line's reference number, the deposit account reference number, the source cleaning line reference number, the amount credited in USD with 2 decimal places, and the posting date in YYYY-MM-DD form. The receipt means the credit was recorded.

**Hypothetical receipt shape.** "Dispute credit posted: credit line ... on deposit account ... against cleaning line ..., amount 42.50 USD, posted 2025-06-30." The amount shown is illustrative only.
